title: Tanzania Travel Checklist: Four Weeks Before You Leave
excerpt: Four weeks before you leave for Tanzania: a checklist of everything to arrange, from visa to packing.
body:
## Four weeks before

- [ ] Visa applied. See [visa guide](/blog/tanzania-visa-guide/).
- [ ] Vaccinations and malaria advice. See [vaccinations](/blog/tanzania-vaccinations/).
- [ ] Travel insurance checked.
- [ ] Zanzibar insurance arranged, if relevant.

## Two weeks before

- [ ] Passport valid for six months.
- [ ] Copies of documents.
- [ ] Bank informed; cards working abroad.
- [ ] US dollars in new notes.
- [ ] eSIM or SIM plan.

## One week before

- [ ] Packing. See [packing mistakes](/blog/safari-packing-mistakes/).
- [ ] No plastic bags.
- [ ] Medication and travel kit.
- [ ] Downloaded maps and books.

## Day before

- [ ] Check flight times.
- [ ] Charge batteries.

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
